The motivation for this project was to model the technical and economic feasibility of the proposed process and evaluate its potential impact to the photovoltaic Si supply chain. 6. Project Objectives: The objective of this project was to model the Si deposition process and perform technoeconomic analysis on a proposed CVD-Fz reactor that combines poly-Si deposition and boule growth in a single chamber. The proposed reactor has the potential to significantly reduce costs and energy inputs related to the production of photovoltaic grade Si wafers, but it represents a significant deviation from current commercial processes and therefore contains significant risk. The goal of the project was to evaluate the feasibility of the process technically and economically in order to de-risk the concept before devoting significant capital resources to building a physical reactor. Furthermore, a goal of this project was to develop a computational model of the system that could rapidly optimize the reactor design to aid future design of a physical system. Success of this technology could increase U.S. competitiveness in crystalline Si manufacturing, helping to onshore manufacturing of this technology and strengthen supply chains for this critically important material. This technology could be one way to disrupt the status quo in Si ingot manufacturing and could be deployed by a U.S. based partner. Furthermore, the technology has the potential to increase the efficiency and reduce the cost and energy intensity of photovoltaics manufacturing, increasing the abundance of low-cost energy for the broader public. A summary of the tasks related to these objectives is given below: Task 1.1: Reactor design and modeling Task Description: This task aims to lower the cost and energy intensity silicon PV manufacturing by modeling a concept for an innovative boule growth process that circumvents the energy-costly Siemens process in polycrystalline Si production plants. The proposed design uses the high-purity, TCS precursor gas used for Siemens to grow the poly-Si feed rod in-situ during a modified Fz boule growth process. The team will develop a multi-phase, 3D CFD model of a combined CVD- Fz pull reactor consisting of a vapor phase and a condensed phase (boule+melt) using multiphysics modeling software. We will develop a final design report containing an optimized design that can be experimentally validated as future follow- on work.
